title: MOS Dynamic RAM Competes with Magnetic Core Memory on Price
lineage: CHM describes 1970 Intel 1103, attributes contributions and reports 1 cent per bit, while noting earlier 1968 and 1969 DRAMs. Intel 1103 used three transistor cell, not later single-transistor scheme.
